retrospective_entries.phase: Tier 0/1: CLI Git Diff Ingestion & Adversarial Quarantine Isolation
retrospective_entries.summary: User queried why only 1 bug was detected on workstation diff. Root cause: 1) Monolithic git diff was quarantined on presets.py prompt injection test string, halting full scan; 2) Raw diff syntax and non-Python files caused AST SyntaxError when split; 3) Deleted diff lines triggered false DLP alarms. Fix: Isolated per-file diff analysis, bypass AST for non-Python assets, inspect actual Python source on disk, and filter deleted lines in diff DLP scanning.
action_items: Per-file AST/DLP isolation verified with clean output
